svg.title: Routing intent sends everything through the hub firewall
svg.desc: The routing intent ri-vhub makes afw-vhub the next hop for private traffic (the RFC 1918 ranges) and internet traffic (0.0.0.0/0), and conn-spoke1's internet security setting gives the spoke the hub's 0.0.0.0/0. The firewall's policy fwp-vhub then allows TCP 22 and ping between the spokes and *.ubuntu.com on HTTP and HTTPS; anything else, such as port 80 between the spokes or www.microsoft.com, is denied.
